description: Private creator studio workflows with a local recording, editing and export hub for laptop and paired phone use.

defaultPrompt: Plan my next EmberBanter gaming stream.
Develop an EmberBanter podcast episode with researched talking points.
Check my streaming and podcast setup and work through the remaining device tests.
interface.longDescription: Plan streams and podcasts, inspect local software, prepare clips and revenue scenarios, and use the bundled creator hub to import recordings, arrange cuts, add corrected captions, render video or podcast files, and review local OBS recording, scene and mixer actions. A local MCP adapter can inspect the hub, save edit sessions and propose actions; the owner approves execution in the hub. Laptop execution is required. Phone web controls need a private HTTPS connection; ChatGPT mobile does not run local stdio tools. No hosted bridge, go-live or publishing integration is claimed.

name: emberbanter-studio
